facts.fact: ARPTC's 2026 tariff page lists 30-day mobile data bundles of USD 10 for 10 GB (Orange, Airtel) and for 13 GB (Vodacom) and 16 GB (Africell), the cheapest 30-day plans of 5 GB or more.
ARPTC's 2026 internet tariff page lists Starlink with a monthly subscription of USD 60 among the fixed internet providers, and lists Konnect Africa with no tariff given.
